abilities.name: Consume
abilities.text: When this Unit resolves a Special Ability that costs BM, it can remove one model from a Friendly Unit Within 4″ to generate 1 BM to spend towards that ability's cost.

abilities.name: Gestate Dark Swarm
abilities.text: Set a Dark Swarm token in an unoccupied space Within 4″ and Line of Sight of this Unit. The Dark Swarm token has DISPLACEMENT.

abilities.name: Dark Swarm
abilities.text: Use when a Friendly Unit Within 4″ of a Friendly Dark Swarm token is selected as the target of an attack. If this Unit is Within 4″ of the same token, the Targeted Friendly Unit is eligible to make an Evade Roll against that attack. If the targeted Unit is a Size 1, it gains a +1 Modifier to this Evade Roll.

abilities.name: Devastating Charge
abilities.text: Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge, resolve the IMPACT (4) 4+ effect.

upgrades.name: Burrow Ambush
upgrades.text: When this Unit is nominated to deploy from Reserves, it may resolve the PLACE (18) effect from the controlling player's Entry Edge. No model may be placed Within 10″ of any Enemy model. This Unit's Activation ends.

upgrades.name: Plague
upgrades.text: You may spend 1 to 3 BM to activate this ability. Set a Plague Blast Template Wholly Within 10″ and Line of Sight of this Unit. For each Unit that has at least one model whose base is partially covered by the template, roll 2 dice, plus 1 additional die for each model in that Unit whose base is partially covered. That Unit loses its HIDDEN Status, and, depending on the BM spent, it suffers NON-LETHAL DAMAGE (1) for: 1 BM: each result of 5+. 2 BM: each result of 4+. 3 BM: each result of 3+.
